description: Chart component designed to display either pie or a donut chart with integrated tooltips and legend.

props.gaugeCut: Allows removing bottom part of the chart to make it into a gauge. Expects angle (0-180).
props.hoverScale: Enables interactive behavior by reducing segment size until it gets hovered. Expects fraction value (0-0.25).
props.innerCut: Specifies inner radius for a donut-style chart as a percent (0-100). Without `hide-slice`, inner slice is visible with translucent color matching the item.
props.items: Data items expected to contain a unique `key`, `title` and a finite, non-negative numeric `value`. Invalid values are treated as zero. Missing or duplicate keys use internal rendering keys.
props.legend: Controls legend visibility, position and text format.
props.maxVisibleItems: Limits the number of individual slices to a positive integer. Remaining items are grouped into an Other slice. Invalid limits leave all items ungrouped.
props.otherColor: Sets the color used by the aggregated Other slice. Defaults to a blend of the theme's primary and error colors.
props.palette: Defines colors and patterns to be applied based on the data items order. Data items can also define their colors.
props.size: Sets the height and width of the chart (excluding title and legend).
props.tooltip: Controls tooltip visibility, transition, offset from the cursor and formats of title and subtitle.
props.itemTitle: Property on supplied `items` that contains its title.
props.itemValue: Property on supplied `items` that contains its value.
props.itemKey: Property on supplied `items` that contains its unique key.

slots.center: Slot used to put custom content in the center of the chart
slots.legend: Slot used to override how legend is being displayed
slots.legend-text: Slot used to customize as text content of single legend item
slots.title: Slot used to customize the title above the chart
slots.tooltip: Slot used to customize tooltip content
